text:
If you’re heading out for the sunset, the evening is still on your side: partly cloudy, around 70, with a north breeze near 14 mph and sunset at 6:42. The breeze will stay with us tonight, turning gusty at times, with clouds thickening and a 30% chance of showers after 2am. Expect a low near 54. A Lake Wind Advisory is up, with north winds on Champlain at 15 to 25 knots and waves around 1 to 3 feet, so this isn’t a night for lingering on the broad water.

Sunday looks cooler and cloudier, with a chance of showers starting after 7am, a high near 68, and a north wind of 8 to 14 mph. The lake stays rough early, then eases later. Enjoy the sunset, but plan on a jacket tonight and keep small boats close to shore through Sunday morning.
